ann.t: Press Release — Varmora Granito Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 19, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results of Varmora Granito Limited for the First Quarter ended June 30, 2026 and the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — Varmora Granito Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Varmora Granito Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
